interactions.headline: The five reforms run alone add about 19,900 homes (likely range 12,000 to 30,600) in 2027-2031; together they add about 20,500 homes (likely range 12,400 to 31,300). The difference, worked out in each simulated future, is +480 homes (likely range 206 to 1,140).
